Safdar also addressed the health condition of Bushra Bibi, noting that her eyesight is severely affected and that she is scheduled for another operation on November 15. While the Islamabad advocate general presented records showing she receives medical care, Safdar requested an independent medical board examination.

The £190 million case, also referred to as the Al-Qadir Trust case, stems from allegations that Imran Khan and others in 2019 approved a confidential settlement regarding £190 million—equivalent to Rs50 billion—sent by Britain's National Crime Agency to the Pakistani government. Following an accountability court ruling, Imran Khan was previously sentenced to 14 years in prison with a Rs1 million fine, while Bushra Bibi received a seven-year sentence and a Rs500,000 fine. The Islamabad High Court also addressed delays regarding defense preparation and paper books, granting time for the legal teams to prepare for the next session.

stories.title: Pakistan Controls First Test Against Sri Lanka After Reaching 434 and Taking Three Wickets
stories.summary:
Pakistan strengthened their position on the opening Test against Sri Lanka on Tuesday by declaring their first innings at 434 for nine and reducing the visitors to 114 for three at the close of the second day at the Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium. Sri Lanka trail by 320 runs and will resume their innings with Kamindu Mendis unbeaten on 40 and Dhananjaya de Silva on 22, after bad light brought an early end to play following 27.1 overs.

Resuming their overnight score of 281 for five, Pakistan built a substantial total thanks to strong lower-order batting. Saud Shakeel added 96 runs for the sixth wicket with debutant Ghazi Ghori, eventually top-scoring with 93 runs off 199 balls before being caught behind off Asitha Fernando. Ghazi contributed 48 runs, while fellow debutant Arafat Minhas scored an impressive 52 off 72 deliveries. In total, five Pakistani batters reached half-centuries, including debutants Tayyab Arif with 57 and Mohammad Taha with 51, alongside captain Babar Azam. Fernando and Dilshan Madushanka each claimed three wickets for Sri Lanka.

In response, Pakistan's fast bowlers quickly put the touring side under pressure. Mohammad Abbas removed opener Pasindu Sooriyabandara for a duck, and debutant Saqib Khan dismissed Dinesh Chandimal for one run. Lahiru Udara offered resistance with 42 runs before becoming Saqib's second victim, leaving Sri Lanka struggling at three wickets down.

Mendis and de Silva subsequently stabilized the innings through an unbroken 49-run partnership, preventing further damage before fading light forced the umpires to call stumps. Sri Lanka faces a difficult challenge on the third day to reduce their massive deficit and stay competitive in the match.

stories.title: PTI Chairman Gohar Ali Khan Defends Interaction With Former Army Chief Bajwa
stories.summary:
Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf Chairman Barrister Gohar Ali Khan defended his brief interaction with former army chief General Qamar Javed Bajwa after a photograph of the two shaking hands at a wedding ceremony circulated widely on social media. The image drew sharp criticism and calls for his resignation from various party officials and supporters, who hold General Bajwa responsible for the ouster of the PTI government in 2022. Speaking to reporters on Adiala Road in Rawalpindi, Gohar dismissed the encounter as a simple exchange of greetings with no further discussion.

Gohar condemned the backlash as propaganda and emphasized that political differences should not evolve into permanent animosity. He stated that relationships can shift over time, asserting that hatred must come to an end. Addressing other political matters, Gohar confirmed that PTI will participate in the upcoming local government elections and noted that candidates have been instructed to prepare nomination papers for the three constituencies in Islamabad.

The PTI chairman also addressed judicial matters and party relations, expressing hope that the Islamabad High Court's recent order regarding meetings with incarcerated founder Imran Khan will be implemented after two years of restrictions. He reported that information regarding Imran Khan's health brought by Barrister Salman Safdar was concerning and reiterated demands for the implementation of the Supreme Court's August 18 order. Gohar added that while PTI maintains contact with the government and the interior minister, no formal negotiations are currently underway.

Furthermore, Gohar discussed regional politics and inter-party relations, noting that discussions with Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam-Fazl chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman focused on a proposed All Parties Conference. Regarding Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa, Gohar stated that governor's rule or an emergency is not an acceptable substitute for a democratic government and demanded an immediate end to such measures.

stories.title: MEPCO Approves One-Time Pay Increment for Twenty-Four Employees Who Memorized the Quran
stories.summary:
The Multan Electric Power Company (MEPCO) has approved a one-time additional advance increment for 24 employees who have memorized the Holy Quran. The official notification was issued to honor their religious achievement, carrying the approval of MEPCO Chief Executive Officer Engineer Gul Muhammad Zahid and Chief HR and Career Planning Officer Mian Muhammad Sohail Afzal. The financial incentive will be applied to the employees' existing basic pay scales starting from November 1, 2025.

The beneficiaries belong to various departments across MEPCO's jurisdiction, including Operations, Grid System Operations (GSO), Material Management, and corporate offices. Selected staff members represent multiple operational circles such as Sahiwal, Multan, Vehari, Muzaffargarh, Bahawalpur, and Rahim Yar Khan, alongside personnel from headquarters departments like Accounts and Services and the Chief Engineer O&M Distribution Office.

To qualify for this special benefit under company policy, employees must provide an authentic Quran memorization certificate issued by a government-recognized seminary or an institution registered with the relevant educational board. This initiative formally recognizes the dedication of staff members who successfully completed the Hifz of the Holy Quran while maintaining their professional duties across the utility provider's network.
